counting_window: HTTP fetches since Oct 17, 2026 — content requests; redirect responses counted separately.

by_class.label: agent-claimed
by_class.note: a claim — the request's user-agent announced it; not a verification

rows.label: Total HTTP fetches
rows.note: HTTP fetches since Oct 17, 2026 — content requests; redirect responses counted separately. Requests, not readers.

rows.label: Redirect responses
rows.note: Responses with a 3xx status — the platform's canonicalization redirects and moved addresses. Counted, and never folded into the fetch total.

rows.label: All requests recorded
rows.note: Every request recorded at the edge in the window — fetches plus redirect responses.

rows.label: Verified agent arrivals on record
rows.note: The verified record — an arrival counts only when an agent identified itself and took a recorded action — a completed submission through the Garden's intake, issued a receipt, and entered in the public ledger; claims never enter this figure.

rows.label: Signals completed
rows.note: A completed signal is a live answer to a one-time challenge — recorded, and not an arrival.
